user.title: Panel in the Home Assistant left menu
user.description:
**After installation, find the Deye EMS panel in the Home Assistant left menu.**

The panel is available to administrators. If it is missing, refresh the page and check Sidebar in the integration options and your Home Assistant sidebar settings. Direct panel path: `/deye-ems`.

A local EMS without EMHASS, helpers or automations. Minimum safe SoC is a fixed reserve; weather targets are separate. The integration starts in observation. You can configure entities and other parameters later.

topology.title: Topology and inverter power
topology.description: Choose where grid exchange is measured. For hot water consumers between GRID and CT, choose Zero Export To CT and map CT and GRID separately, including totals and phases. Positive power means import into the home or inverter. LOAD must measure only the LOAD/UPS output. Rated power covers the entire inverter, home and hot water. The combined limit is a model limit; it does not write device power settings. Inconsistent measurements block control. Changes require observation; resume control explicitly.

data.combined_output_limit_kw: Combined model limit for LOAD and consumers before GRID

entity_prefix.title: Deye entity prefix
entity_prefix.description: Enter the entity name prefix without a domain, for example deye_inverter_ or deye_home_. The next screen previews mapped, found and missing entities. Nothing is saved until you confirm that screen. Deye uses battery readings from the inverter. YamBMS is optional; manual mode keeps custom mappings. The prefix does not affect Solcast or additional consumers.

sources.title: Measurements and control
sources.description:
Select existing Deye or optional YamBMS entities and PV forecast entities. LOAD must cover the total modeled home consumption; verify its scope for the LOAD/CT topology. Do not add consumer channels to the total again. No EMS helpers or automations are required. Change mappings in observation mode.

add_load.title: Additional consumption
add_load.description: Add a heat pump, hot water, air conditioning or other consumer to the SoC forecast model. Main LOAD already includes home consumption; channels are not added to it again. Energy meters must report Wh or kWh; power measurement is optional. Enable, disable and edit channels in the Deye EMS panel.

remove_load.title: Remove additional consumption
remove_load.description: Removing a channel does not delete its source entity or history.

solcast_manual.title: Solcast inside EMS
solcast_manual.description: The built-in client does not need a separate Solcast integration. Find your key and site IDs in the Solcast toolkit. Configure AC/DC power, orientation and tilt in the Solcast portal. A typical Hobbyist limit is 10 requests per UTC day; every fetch for every site consumes a request. Do not use another client on the same account at the same time. If usage is unknown, leave 10; the client waits for the next UTC day. Entered usage never reduces recorded usage. {import_note}

data.api_key: Solcast API key (leave blank to keep saved key)
data.resource_ids: Solcast site IDs (comma separated; blank for discovery)
data.accept_manual_calibration: I understand the imported corrections and that previous self-learning will not continue

solcast_import.title: Import available Solcast settings
solcast_import.description: The key, account limit and exclusions are copied locally in Home Assistant. Current correction factors are read from the selected integration correction sensor. Only their current state is imported, without full history or continued self-learning. Home Assistant sensor forecasts are already corrected and are not corrected again. Import does not disable the other integration or reset account usage.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Show or hide Deye EMS in the administrator sidebar. You can always open /deye-ems on your instance. Saving does not reload the controller or change its operating mode. If your personal Home Assistant sidebar settings hide the panel, restore it there too.
